Title: App Service SSL connection pricing changes

Body.Content:
There are pricing changes for SSL Hosting (bindings) for Azure App Service. Azure App Service customers can now enjoy free Server Name Indication (SNI) SSL connections for Basic, Standard, and Premium service plans. There are no changes to IP SSL connection prices. For more information, see:
  • Pricing
  • App Service webpage
